items.claim: Jan Blachowicz is fighting at the age of 43.
items.quote: return of Yan Bohovich at the ripe age of 43.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling is taking the fight on short notice as a replacement for Bogdan Guskov.
items.quote: Fighting Navajo Sterling, who is taking this fight on, I guess somewhat of short notice. He's stepping in for Bdon Gusov

items.claim: Navajo Sterling has started knocking guys out recently after earlier criticism regarding his lack of finishes.
items.quote: he's finally starting to knock guys out. That was a big knock on Navajo Sterling earlier in his UFC career.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling has been taken down repeatedly by opponents like Ibo Aslan, Abdul Razak Alhassan, and Tuco Tokkos in the past.
items.quote: We saw Ewan Cout Lava take him down a bunch... Adulo Bolado get a couple of takedowns. We saw Tuco Tokos take this guy down a few times.

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz can secure takedowns against Navajo Sterling if he chooses to.
items.quote: I think if Yonhovich wants to, he can get him to the fence. He could shoot for that single leg and he can get in top position.

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz has faced an elite strength of schedule including champions like Magomed Ankalaev, Alex Pereira, Glover Teixeira, and Israel Adesanya.
items.quote: He's fighting champions. He's fighting Magamed Ankollay. He is fighting Alex Para, fighting Carlos Olberg, fighting Bogdan Gusov, Alexander Rakage, Glover Terara, Israel Adosana.
